name: spotify-mcp-server
description: Control your Spotify from Claude: play and pause, search, queue songs, and build or clean up playlists. Needs your own Spotify developer app credentials.

client_id.title: Spotify Client ID
client_id.description: From your app in the Spotify developer dashboard.

client_secret.title: Spotify Client Secret
client_secret.description: From the same app's Settings page. Keep it private.

redirect_uri.title: Redirect URI
redirect_uri.description: Must match the Redirect URI in your Spotify app exactly. Use 127.0.0.1, not localhost.

tools.name: spotify_login
tools.description: Log in to Spotify through the browser.

tools.name: spotify_get_current_playback
tools.description: Get the currently playing track and whether playback is active.

tools.name: spotify_get_available_devices
tools.description: List Spotify devices visible to the account.

tools.name: spotify_search_track
tools.description: Search for tracks and get their URIs (1 to 10 results).

tools.name: spotify_play
tools.description: Start or resume playback, optionally a specific track.

tools.name: spotify_add_to_queue
tools.description: Add a track to the end of the queue.

tools.name: spotify_get_user_playlists
tools.description: List the user's playlists with ids and track counts.

tools.name: spotify_get_playlist_tracks
tools.description: List all tracks in a playlist.

tools.name: spotify_remove_tracks_from_playlist
tools.description: Remove tracks from a playlist, including every copy of each.
